{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Expenditure Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of research and development expenditures over the past 5 years, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with more volatile R&D expenditures may be taking on more risk and pursuing more innovative projects, leading to higher potential returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "Calculate the difference in inventory turnover between the current year and the average of the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with accelerating inventory turnover may be experiencing increasing demand or improving operational efficiency, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Accounts Payable Days Deceleration", "construction": "Calculate the difference in accounts payable days between the current year and the average of the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with decelerating accounts payable days may be experiencing decreasing supplier credit or improving cash management, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Capital Expenditure Reversal", "construction": "Calculate the difference in capital expenditures between the current year and the average of the past 3 years, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with reversing capital expenditures may be adjusting to changing market conditions or improving resource allocation, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Expense Persistence", "construction": "Calculate the autocorrelation of advertising expenses over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with persistent advertising expenses may be building strong brands or experiencing increasing returns to marketing, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Calculate the average annual growth rate of employees over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with high employee growth rates may be experiencing increasing demand or improving operational efficiency, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Dividend Payout Ratio Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of the dividend payout ratio over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with more volatile dividend payout ratios may be experiencing changing cash flows or adjusting to changing market conditions, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Current Asset Liquidity", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of current assets to current liabilities, excluding cash and cash equivalents", "rationale": "Firms with high current asset liquidity may be experiencing increasing financial flexibility or improving operational efficiency, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Tangible Asset Intensity", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of tangible assets to total assets", "rationale": "Firms with high tangible asset intensity may be experiencing increasing returns to capital or improving operational efficiency, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Executive Compensation Sensitivity", "construction": "Calculate the sensitivity of executive compensation to stock price performance over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with high executive compensation sensitivity may be experiencing increasing alignment between management and shareholder interests, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
